sections.label: Book 7
sections.name: The cups of Soma at the morning and midday pressings

verses.sa: वाचस्पतये पवस्व वृष्णो अंशुभ्यां गभस्तिपूतः। देवो देवेभ्यः पवस्व येषां भागोऽसि॥
verses.tr: vācaspataye pavasva vṛṣṇo aṃśubhyāṃ gabhastipūtaḥ devo devebhyaḥ pavasva yeṣāṃ bhāgo'si
verses.en: Flow/ for Brihaspati, cleansed by hands from the two off shoots of the Bull. Flow pure, a Deity thyself, for Deities whose share thou art.

verses.sa: मधुमतीर्न इषस्कृधि यत्ते सोमादाभ्यं नाम जागृवि तस्मै ते सोम सोमाय स्वाहा स्वाहोर्वन्तरिक्षमन्वेमि॥
verses.tr: madhumatīrna iṣaskṛdhi yatte somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi tasmai te soma somāya svāhā svāhorvantarikṣamanvemi
verses.en: Sweeten the freshening draughts we drink. Soma, whatever name thou hast, unconquerable, giving life, 1*0 that thy Soma, Soma! Hail!

verses.sa: स्वाङ्कृतोऽसि विश्वेभ्य इन्द्रियेभ्यो दिव्येभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यो मनस्त्वाष्टु स्वाहा त्वा सुभव सूर्याय देवेभ्यस्त्वा मरीचिपेभ्यो देवांशो यस्मै त्वेडे तत्सत्यमुपरिप्रुता भङ्गेन हतोऽसौ फ़ट् प्राणाय त्वा व्यानाय त्वा॥
verses.tr: svāṅkṛto'si viśvebhya indriyebhyo divyebhyaḥ pārthivebhyo manastvāṣṭu svāhā tvā subhava sūryāya devebhyastvā marīcipebhyo devāṃśo yasmai tveḍe tatsatyamupariprutā bhaṅgena hato'sau faṭ prāṇāya tvā vyānāya tvā
verses.en: Self-made art thou from all the Powers that are in heaven and on the earth. May the Mind win thee, thee. All-hail! for Surya, O thou nobly-born. Thee for the Deities who sip light-atoms. Truly fulfilled, O Plant divine, be that for which I pray to thee. With ruin falling from above may So-and-So be smitten, crash! Thee for outbreathing, thee for breath diffused!

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यन्तर्यच्छ मघवन् पाहि सोमम्। उरुष्य राय एषो यजस्व॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'syantaryaccha maghavan pāhi somam uruṣya rāya eṣo yajasva
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Hold in. Rich Lord! Be Soma's guard. Be thou protector of our wealth: win strengthening food by sacrifice.

verses.sa: अन्तस्ते द्यावापृथिवी दधाम्यन्तर्दधाम्युर्वन्तरिक्षम्। सजूर्देवेभिरवरैः परैश्चान्तर्यामे मघवन् मादयस्व॥
verses.tr: antaste dyāvāpṛthivī dadhāmyantardadhāmyurvantarikṣam sajūrdevebhiravaraiḥ paraiścāntaryāme maghavan mādayasva
verses.en: The heaven and spacious earth I lay within thee, I lay within thee middle air's wide region. Accordant with the Gods lower and higher, Rich Lord, rejoice thee in the Antaryama.

verses.sa: स्वाङ्कृतोऽसि विश्वेभ्य इन्द्रियेभ्यो दिव्येभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यो मनस्त्वाष्टु स्वाहा त्वा सुभव सूर्याय देवेभ्यस्त्वा मरीचिपेभ्य उदानाय त्वा॥
verses.tr: svāṅkṛto'si viśvebhya indriyebhyo divyebhyaḥ pārthivebhyo manastvāṣṭu svāhā tvā subhava sūryāya devebhyastvā marīcipebhya udānāya tvā
verses.en: Self-made art thou light-atoms (verse 3 repeated). Thee for the upward breath.

verses.sa: आ वायो भूष शुचिपा उप नः सहस्रं ते नियुतो विश्ववार। उपो ते अन्धो मद्यमयामि यस्य देव दधिषे पूर्वपेयं वायवे त्वा॥
verses.tr: ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā upa naḥ sahasraṃ te niyuto viśvavāra upo te andho madyamayāmi yasya deva dadhiṣe pūrvapeyaṃ vāyave tvā
verses.en: O Vayu, drinker of the pure, be near us: a thousand teams are thine, All-bounteous Giver. To thee the rapture-giving juice is offered, whose first draught, God, thou takest as thy portion.

verses.sa: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरागतम्। इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां त्वैष ते योनिः सजोषोभ्यां त्वा॥
verses.tr: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirāgatam indavo vāmuśanti hi upayāmagṛhīto'si vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yoniḥ sajoṣobhyāṃ tvā
verses.en: These, Indra-Vayu! Have been shed; come for our offered dainties' sake: The drops are yearning for you both. Taken Upon a base art thou. For Vayu, Indra-Vayu, thee. This is thy home. Thee for the close-knit friends.

verses.sa: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा। ममेदिह श्रुतं हवम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā mamediha śrutaṃ havam upayāmagṛhīto'si mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā
verses.en: This Soma hath been shed for you. Law-strengtheners, Maitravaruna! Here listen ye to this my call. Taken upon a base art thou. For Mitra thee, for Varuna.

verses.sa: राया वयं ससवांसो मदेम हव्येन देवा यवसेन गावः। तां धेनुं मित्रावरुणा युवं नो विश्वाहा धत्तमनपस्फ़ुरन्तीमेष ते योनिरृतायुभ्यां त्वा॥
verses.tr: rāyā vayaṃ sasavāṃso madema havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ tāṃ dhenuṃ mitrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattamanapasfurantīmeṣa te yonirṛtāyubhyāṃ tvā
verses.en: May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblation, and the kine in pasture; And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily. This is thy home. Thee for the righteous Twain.

verses.sa: या वां कशा मधुमत्यश्विना सूनृतावती। तया यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यश्विभ्यां त्वैष ते योनिर्माध्वीभ्यां त्वा॥
verses.tr: yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yonirmādhvībhyāṃ tvā
verses.en: Distilling honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness: Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home. Thee for the Honey-lovers.

verses.sa: तं प्रत्नथा पूर्वथा विश्वथेमथा ज्येष्ठतातिं बर्हिषदं स्वर्विदम्। प्रतीचीनं वृजनं दोहसे धुनिमाशुं जयन्तमनु यासु वर्धसे। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि शण्डाय त्वैष ते योनिर्वीरतां पाह्यपमृष्टः शण्डो देवास्त्वा शुक्रपाः प्र णयन्त्वनाधृष्टाऽसि॥
verses.tr: taṃ pratnathā pūrvathā viśvathemathā jyeṣṭhatātiṃ barhiṣadaṃ svarvidam pratīcīnaṃ vṛjanaṃ dohase dhunimāśuṃ jayantamanu yāsu vardhase upayāmagṛhīto'si śaṇḍāya tvaiṣa te yonirvīratāṃ pāhyapamṛṣṭaḥ śaṇḍo devāstvā śukrapāḥ pra ṇayantvanādhṛṣṭā'si
verses.en: Thou in the first old time, as all were wont, so now drawest from him, light-finder, throned on sacred grass; Preeminence and strength, from him turned hither, swift, roaring, who winneth those whereby thou waxest strong. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Sanda. This is thy home. Protect thou manly power. Sanda hath been removed, may Deities who drink the pure libation lead thee forward. Invincible art thou.

verses.sa: सुवीरो वीरान् प्रजनयन् परीह्यभि रायस्पोषेण यजमानम्। सञ्जग्मानो दिवा पृथिव्या शुक्रः शुक्रशोचिषा निरस्तः शण्डः शुक्रस्याधिष्ठानमसि॥
verses.tr: suvīro vīrān prajanayan parīhyabhi rāyaspoṣeṇa yajamānam sañjagmāno divā pṛthivyā śukraḥ śukraśociṣā nirastaḥ śaṇḍaḥ śukrasyādhiṣṭhānamasi
verses.en: Well stored with heroes and begetting heroes, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Bright, conjoined with Heaven and with Earth, with the brightly-shining one. Expelled is Sar-ida. Thou art Sukra's dwelling.

verses.sa: अच्छिन्नस्य ते देव सोम सुवीर्यस्य रायस्पोषस्य ददितारः स्याम। सा प्रथमा सँस्कृतिर्विश्ववारा स प्रथमो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: acchinnasya te deva soma suvīryasya rāyaspoṣasya daditāraḥ syāma sā prathamā saṃskṛtirviśvavārā sa prathamo varuṇo mitro agniḥ
verses.en: May we, O radiant Soma, be the keepers of thine uninjured strength and growth of riches. This is the first all bounteous Consecration: he the first, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni.

verses.sa: स प्रथमो बृहस्पतिश्चिकित्वाँस्तस्मा इन्द्राय सुतमा जुहोत स्वाहा। तृम्पन्तु होत्रा मध्वो याः स्विष्टा याः सुप्रीताः सुहुता यत्स्वाहा ऽयाडग्नीत्॥
verses.tr: sa prathamo bṛhaspatiścikitvāṃstasmā indrāya sutamā juhota svāhā tṛmpantu hotrā madhvo yāḥ sviṣṭā yāḥ suprītāḥ suhutā yatsvāhā 'yāḍagnīt
verses.en: He is the first Brihaspati, the Prudent. Offer ye juice with Svaha! to that Indra. Content be priestly offices, those with good sacrifice of meath, those that are pleased when they have gained fair offerings with the solemn Hail! The Kindler of the Fire hath sacrificed.

verses.sa: अयं वेनश्चोदयत्पृश्निगर्भा ज्योतिर्जरायू रजसो विमाने। इममपां संगमे सूर्यस्य शिशुं न विप्रा मतिभी रिहन्ति। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि मर्काय त्वा॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ venaścodayatpṛśnigarbhā jyotirjarāyū rajaso vimāne imamapāṃ saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti upayāmagṛhīto'si markāya tvā
verses.en: See, Vena, born in light hath driven hither on chariot of Prisni. Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Marka.

verses.sa: मनो न येषु हवनेषु तिग्मं विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता। आ यः शर्याभिस्तुविनृम्णो अस्याश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्तावेष ते योनिः प्रजाः पाह्यपमृष्टो मर्को देवास्त्वा मन्थिपाः प्र णयन्त्वनाधृष्टासि॥
verses.tr: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastāveṣa te yoniḥ prajāḥ pāhyapamṛṣṭo marko devāstvā manthipāḥ pra ṇayantvanādhṛṣṭāsi
verses.en: To his oblation, swift as thought ye hurried and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered. With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant. This is thy dwelling-place. Protect the people. Marka hath been removed. Gods, drinkers of the Manthin, lead thee forward Invincible art thou.

verses.sa: सुप्रजाः प्रजाः प्रजनयन् परीह्यभि रायस्पोषेण यजमानम्। सञ्जग्मानो दिवा पृथिव्या मन्थी मन्थिशोचिषा निरस्तो मर्को मन्थिनोऽधिष्ठानमसि॥
verses.tr: suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhyabhi rāyaspoṣeṇa yajamānam sañjagmāno divā pṛthivyā manthī manthiśociṣā nirasto marko manthino'dhiṣṭhānamasi
verses.en: Well stored with people and begetting people, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Manthin joined with Heaven and Earth and with the Manthin-shining one. Expelled i? Marka. Thou art Manthin's dwelling.

verses.sa: ये देवासो दिव्येकादश स्थ पृथिव्यामध्येकादश स्थ। अप्सुक्षितो महिनैकादश स्थ ते देवासो यज्ञमिमं जुषध्वम्॥
verses.tr: ye devāso divyekādaśa stha pṛthivyāmadhyekādaśa stha apsukṣito mahinaikādaśa stha te devāso yajñamimaṃ juṣadhvam
verses.en: O ye eleven Gods whose home is heaven, O ye eleven who make earth your dwelling. Ye who with might, eleven, live in waters, accept this sacrifice, Ye Gods, with pleasure.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽस्याग्रयणोऽसि स्वाग्रयणः। पाहि यज्ञं पाहि यज्ञपतिं विष्णुस्त्वामिन्द्रियेण पातु विष्णुं त्वं पाह्यभि सवनानि पाहि॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'syāgrayaṇo'si svāgrayaṇaḥ pāhi yajñaṃ pāhi yajñapatiṃ viṣṇustvāmindriyeṇa pātu viṣṇuṃ tvaṃ pāhyabhi savanāni pāhi
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art Agrayana, good first libation. Be thou the guard of sacrifice: protect the sacrifice's lord. Vishnu with might protect thee. Guard thou Vishnu. Guard on all sides the Soma sacrifices.

verses.sa: सोमः पवते सोमः पवतेऽस्मै ब्रह्मणेऽस्मै क्षत्रायास्मै सुन्वते यजमानाय पवत इष ऊर्जे पवतेऽद्भ्य ओषधीभ्यः पवते द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां पवते सुभूताय पवते विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य एष ते योनिर्विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: somaḥ pavate somaḥ pavate'smai brahmaṇe'smai kṣatrāyāsmai sunvate yajamānāya pavata iṣa ūrje pavate'dbhya oṣadhībhyaḥ pavate dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pavate subhūtāya pavate viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ
verses.en: Soma flows pure, Soma flows pure for this Priesthood, for the Nobility, pure for the worshipper who presses out the juice, flows pure for food and energy, for waters and for plants; flows pure for general prosperity. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Universal Gods.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा बृहद्वते वयस्वत उक्थाव्यं गृह्णामि। यत्त इन्द्र बृहद्वयस्तस्मै त्वा विष्णवे त्वैष ते योनिरुक्थेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यस्त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामि॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā bṛhadvate vayasvata ukthāvyaṃ gṛhṇāmi yatta indra bṛhadvayastasmai tvā viṣṇave tvaiṣa te yonirukthebhyastvā devebhyastvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmi
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Lord of the Brihat, strong with vital vigour, I take thee lover of the invocation. Indra, what mighty vigour thou possessest, for that do I take thee, take thee for Vishnu. This is thy home. Thee for the recitations. For the Gods take I thee, the Gods' protector; yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee.

verses.sa: मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन्द्राय त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन्द्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन्द्राबृहस्पतिभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामीन्द्राविष्णुभ्यां त्वा देवाव्यं यज्ञस्यायुषे गृह्णामि॥
verses.tr: mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāya tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrābṛhaspatibhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāviṣṇubhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmi
verses.en: For Maitravaruna thee, the Gods protector, yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee. For Indra, thee, etc. For Indra-Agni, thee, etc. For Indra-Varuoa, thee, etc. For Indra-Brihaspati thee, etc. For Indca-Vishpu thee, etc.

verses.sa: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम्। कविं सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्ना पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ
verses.en: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvanara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि ध्रुवोऽसि ध्रुवक्षितिर्ध्रुवाणां ध्रुवतमोऽच्युतानामच्युतक्षित्तम एष ते योनिर्वैश्वानराय त्वा। ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण मनसा वाचा सोममव नयामि। अथा न इन्द्र इद्विशोऽसपत्नाः समनसस्करत्॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si dhruvo'si dhruvakṣitirdhruvāṇāṃ dhruvatamo'cyutānāmacyutakṣittama eṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa manasā vācā somamava nayāmi athā na indra idviśo'sapatnāḥ samanasaskarat
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. Firm, firmly resting, the firmest of the firm, the most securely grounded of those who never have been shaken. This is thy home. Thee for Vaisvanara. I pour forth with firm mind, with voice, firm Soma. So now may Indra verily make our people all of one heart and mind and free from foemen.

verses.sa: यस्ते द्रप्स स्कन्दति यस्ते अंशुर्ग्रावच्युतो धिषणयोरुपस्थात्। अध्वर्योर्वा परि वा यः पवित्रात्तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतं स्वाहा देवानामुत्क्रमणमसि॥
verses.tr: yaste drapsa skandati yaste aṃśurgrāvacyuto dhiṣaṇayorupasthāt adhvaryorvā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāttaṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ svāhā devānāmutkramaṇamasi
verses.en: Whatever drop of thine leaps forth, whatever stalk from the bowls' lap, shaken by the press-stone, From the Adhvaryu's hand or from the filter, that, consecrated in my mind with Vashat I offer unto thee with cry of Svaha! Thou art the way by which the Gods ascended.

verses.sa: प्राणाय मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व व्यानाय मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वोदानाय मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व वाचे मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व क्रतूदक्षाभ्यां मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व श्रोत्राय मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व चक्षुर्भ्यां मे वर्चोदसौ वर्चसे पवेथाम्॥
verses.tr: prāṇāya me varcodā varcase pavasva vyānāya me varcodā varcase pavasvodānāya me varcodā varcase pavasva vāce me varcodā varcase pavasva kratūdakṣābhyāṃ me varcodā varcase pavasva śrotrāya me varcodā varcase pavasva cakṣurbhyāṃ me varcodasau varcase pavethām
verses.en: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my outward breath. Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my spreading breath. Giver, etc. for my upward breath. Giver, etc. form power of speech. Giver, etc. for my sense and will. Giver, etc. for my hearing power. Givers of splendour, grow ye pure for splendour for my orbs of sight.

verses.sa: आत्मने मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वौजसे मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्वायुषे मे वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व विश्वाभ्यो मे प्रजाभ्यो वर्चोदसौ वर्चसे पवेथाम्॥
verses.tr: ātmane me varcodā varcase pavasvaujase me varcodā varcase pavasvāyuṣe me varcodā varcase pavasva viśvābhyo me prajābhyo varcodasau varcase pavethām
verses.en: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my living self. Giver, etc. for my energy. Giver, etc. for my vital power. Givers of splendour, grow ye pure for splendour for all sprung from me.

verses.sa: कोऽसि कतमोऽसि कस्यासि को नामासि। यस्य ते नामामन्महि यं त्वा सोमेनातीतृपाम। भूर्भुवः स्वः सुप्रजाः प्रजाभिः स्यां सुवीरो वीरैः सुपोषः पोषैः॥
verses.tr: ko'si katamo'si kasyāsi ko nāmāsi yasya te nāmāmanmahi yaṃ tvā somenātītṛpāma bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ suprajāḥ prajābhiḥ syāṃ suvīro vīraiḥ supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ
verses.en: Who art thou? Which of all art thou? Whose art thou? Who art thou by name? Even thou on whose name we have meditated, thou whom we have delighted with our Soma.

verses.sa: उपयामगृहीतोऽसि मधवे त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि माधवाय त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि शुक्राय त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि शुचये त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि नभसे त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि नभस्याय त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसीषे त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽस्यूर्जे त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि सहसे त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि सहस्याय त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि तपसे त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽसि तपस्याय त्वोपयामगृहीतोऽस्यंहसस्पतये त्वा॥
verses.tr: upayāmagṛhīto'si madhave tvopayāmagṛhīto'si mādhavāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si śukrāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si śucaye tvopayāmagṛhīto'si nabhase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si nabhasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'sīṣe tvopayāmagṛhīto'syūrje tvopayāmagṛhīto'si sahase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si sahasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si tapase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si tapasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'syaṃhasaspataye tvā
verses.en: Taken upon a base art thou. For Madhu thee. Taken upon a base art thou. For Madhava thee. Taken, etc. For Sukra thee. Taken, etc. For Suchi thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhas thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhasya thee. Taken, etc. For Food thee. Taken, etc. For Energy thee. Taken, etc. For Sahas thee. Taken, etc. For Sahasya thee. Taken, etc. For Tapas thee. Taken, etc. For Tapasya thee. Taken, etc. For Amhasaspati thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यम्। अस्य पातं धियेषिता। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वैष ते योनिरिन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī ā gataṃ sutaṃ gīrbhirnabho vareṇyam asya pātaṃ dhiyeṣitā upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yonirindrāgnibhyāṃ tvā
verses.en: Moved, Aindragna, by our hymns, come to the juice, the precious dew. Drink ye thereof, impelled by song. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.

verses.sa: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक्। येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा। उपयामगृहीतोऽस्यग्नीन्द्राभ्यां त्वैष ते योनिरग्नीन्द्राभ्यां त्वा॥
verses.tr: ā ghā ye agnimindhate stṛṇanti barhirānuṣak yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā upayāmagṛhīto'syagnīndrābhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yoniragnīndrābhyāṃ tvā
verses.en: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway strew the sacred grass, Whose Friend is Indra ever young. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.

verses.sa: ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो विश्वे देवास आ गत। दाश्वांसो दाशुषः सुतम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य एष ते योनिर्विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa ā gata dāśvāṃso dāśuṣaḥ sutam upayāmagṛhīto'si viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ
verses.en: Ye Visvedevas who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवास आ गत शृणुता म इमं हवम्। एदं बर्हिर्निषीदत। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्य एष ते योनिर्विश्वेभ्यस्त्वा देवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam edaṃ barhirniṣīdata upayāmagṛhīto'si viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ
verses.en: O ye All-Gods, come hitherward: hear this my invocation; seat Yourselves upon this sacred grass. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sa: इन्द्र मरुत्व इह पाहि सोमं यथा शार्याते अपिबः सुतस्य। तव प्रणीती तव शूर शर्मन्ना विवासन्ति कवयः सुयज्ञाः। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वत एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते॥
verses.tr: indra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya tava praṇītī tava śūra śarmannā vivāsanti kavayaḥ suyajñāḥ upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate
verses.en: Here drink the Soma, Indra girt by Maruts! as thou didst drink the juice beside aryata. Under thy guidance, in thy keeping. Hero! The singers serve, skilled in fair sacrifices. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.

verses.sa: मरुत्वन्तं वृषभं वावृधानमकवारिं दिव्यंशासमिन्द्रम्। विश्वासाहमवसे नूतनायोग्रंसहोदामिह तं हुवेम। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि मरुतां त्वौजसे॥
verses.tr: marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaṃśāsamindram viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograṃsahodāmiha taṃ huvema upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvate eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate upayāmagṛhīto'si marutāṃ tvaujase
verses.en: The Bull whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the Celestial Ruler, Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him we invoke to give us new protection. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Maruts' energy.

verses.sa: सजोषा इन्द्र सगणो मरुद्भिः सोमं पिब वृत्रहा शूर विद्वान्। जहि शत्रूँ२रप मृधो नुदस्वाथाभयं कृणुहि विश्वतो नः। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वत एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते॥
verses.tr: sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān jahi śatrūṃ2rapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate
verses.en: Indra, accordant with the banded Maruts, drink Soma, Hero! as wise Vritra-slayer. Slay thou our foe men, drive away assailants, and make us safe on every side from danger. Taken, etc. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.

verses.sa: मरुत्वाँ२ इन्द्र वृषभो रणाय पिबा सोममनुष्वधं मदाय। आ सिञ्चस्व जठरे मध्व ऊर्मिं त्वं राजाऽसि प्रतिपत्सुतानाम्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसीन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वत एष ते योनिरिन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते॥
verses.tr: marutvāṃ2 indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somamanuṣvadhaṃ madāya ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tvaṃ rājā'si pratipatsutānām upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate
verses.en: Drink, Indra Marut-girt, as Bull, the Soma: for joy, for rapture even as thou pleasest. Pour down the wave of meath within thy belly: thou art the King of juices shed fortnightly. Taken, etc Maruts thee (as above).

verses.sa: महाँ२ इन्द्रो नृवदा चर्षणिप्रा उत द्विबर्हा अमिनः सहोभिः। अस्मद्रय्ग्वावृधे वीर्यायोरुः पृथुः सुकृतः कर्तृभिर्भूत्। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि महेन्द्राय त्वैष ते योनिर्महेन्द्राय त्वा॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ2 indro nṛvadā carṣaṇiprā uta dvibarhā aminaḥ sahobhiḥ asmadraygvāvṛdhe vīryāyoruḥ pṛthuḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā
verses.en: Great, hero-like, controlling men is Indra, unwasting in his powers, doubled in vastness. He, turned to us, hath grown to hero vigour: broad, wide, he hath been decked by those who serve him. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Mahendra. This is thy dwelling-place. Thee for Mahendra.

verses.sa: महाँ२ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ२ इव। स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे। उपयामगृहीतोऽसि महेन्द्राय त्वैष ते योनिर्महेन्द्राय त्वा॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ2 indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṃ2 iva stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā
verses.en: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain. Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds. Taken, etc. as in.

verses.sa: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः। दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यं स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ dṛśe viśvāya sūryaṃ svāhā
verses.en: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Surya, that all may look on him. All-hail!

verses.sa: चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः। आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्षं सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca svāhā
verses.en: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. Soul of all moving, soul of all that moves not, the Sun hath filled the air and earth and heaven.

verses.sa: अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान्विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान्। युयोध्यस्मज्जुहुराणमेनो भूयिष्ठां ते नम उक्तिं विधेम स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te nama uktiṃ vidhema svāhā
verses.en: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sa: अयं नो अग्निर्वरिवस्कृणोत्वयं मृधः पुर एतु प्रभिन्दन्। अयं वाजान्जयतु वाजसातावयं शत्रूञ्जयतु जर्हृषाणः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ no agnirvarivaskṛṇotvayaṃ mṛdhaḥ pura etu prabhindan ayaṃ vājānjayatu vājasātāvayaṃ śatrūñjayatu jarhṛṣāṇaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: may he quell foes in his triumphant onset.

verses.sa: रूपेण वो रूपमभ्यागां तुथो वो विश्ववेदा वि भजतु। ऋतस्य पथा प्रेत चन्द्रदक्षिणा वि स्वः पश्य व्यन्तरिक्षं यतस्व सदस्यैः॥
verses.tr: rūpeṇa vo rūpamabhyāgāṃ tutho vo viśvavedā vi bhajatu ṛtasya pathā preta candradakṣiṇā vi svaḥ paśya vyantarikṣaṃ yatasva sadasyaiḥ
verses.en: I through your beauty have attained to beauty. The Tutha, the omniscient, allot you! Go forth, bright-gifted! on the path of Order. Look thou upon the heaven and air's mid-region. Unite thee with the priests who keep the Sadas.

verses.sa: ब्राह्मणमद्य विदेयं पितृमन्तं पैतृमत्यमृषिमार्षेयं सुधातुदक्षिणम्। अस्मद्राता देवत्रा गच्छत प्रदातारमा विशत॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇamadya videyaṃ pitṛmantaṃ paitṛmatyamṛṣimārṣeyaṃ sudhātudakṣiṇam asmadrātā devatrā gacchata pradātāramā viśata
verses.en: This day may it be mine to find a Brahman sprung from a lauded father and grandfather, Offspring of Rishis and himself a Rishi, the fit recipient of priestly guerdon. Go to the Gods, bestowed by me, and enter into him who gives.

verses.sa: अग्नये त्वा मह्यं वरुणो ददातु सोऽमृतत्त्वमशीयायुर्दात्र एधि मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे रुद्राय त्वा मह्यं वरुणो ददातु सोऽमृतत्त्वमशीय प्राणो दात्र एधि वयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे बृहस्पतये त्वा मह्यं वरुणो ददातु सोऽमृतत्त्वमशीय त्वग्दात्र एधि मयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे यमाय त्वा मह्यं वरुणो ददातु सोऽमृतत्त्वमशीय हयो दात्र एधि वयो मह्यं प्रतिग्रहीत्रे॥
verses.tr: agnaye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīyāyurdātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre rudrāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya prāṇo dātra edhi vayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre bṛhaspataye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya tvagdātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre yamāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya hayo dātra edhi vayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
verses.en: To Agni, yea, to me let Varuna give thee. May I gain life that shall endure for ever. Be thou strong vital power to him who gives thee, and comfort unto me the gift's receiver. To Rudra, yea, to me let Varuna for ever. Be thou the breath of life to him who gives thee, and vigour unto me the gift's receiver. To me Brihaspati let Varuna for ever. Be thou a covering skin to him who gives thee, and comfort unto me the gift's receiver. To Yama, yea, to me let Varuna for ever. Be thou a steed to him who gives the guerdon, and vital power to me the gift's receiver.

verses.sa: कोऽदात्कस्मा अदात्कामोऽदात्कामायादात्। कामो दाता कामः प्रतिग्रहीता कामैतत्ते॥
verses.tr: ko'dātkasmā adātkāmo'dātkāmāyādāt kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmaitatte
verses.en: Who hath bestowed it? Upon whom bestowed it? Desire bestowed it, for Desire he gave it. Desire is giver and Desire receiver. This, O Desire, to thee is dedicated.
